tutorial.note: LOG-182 追記③ (the user): the simple stage's opening. `hold` = A1 without drums: its first two beats are the OPENING's own pick-up, part of the pass, not a seam pick-up (追記④, the user: A1 loop只要tail不要pre-entry) - every pass plays from the file's head, a pass is 2 beats + 8 bars, and the tail rings under the next pass (or under A2) loops for as long as the lesson talks; `drums` = layer 2, exactly 8 bars (no pick-up, no tail), faded in as the lesson goes on; `release` = A2, the second half of the intro (no pick-up, 1-bar tail like A's own ending) - scheduled instead of another pass once the lesson is ready to demonstrate, and it hands over to B exactly as A did. durationSec = pick-up + 8 bars + tail at 145 BPM so the logical length is exactly 8 bars. 追記⑥ (the user: 我還是聽到A接A又出現開頭兩拍重複播放): `openBars` = the opening's two beats are heard ONCE, on the first pass only; every later pass starts after them and is exactly eight bars. LOG-184 (the user): the loop now has TWO renders - `firstFile` for the one pass that is heard from the top (the two opening beats included), `file` for every later pass, entered after `openBars`. The two files are the same length, the same head and the same grid (19.0955 s decoded = 2 beats + 8 bars + 3-bar tail @145; first sound 0.0231 s), so one set of bpm / preBars / tailBars / trimStart / durationSec / openBars covers both.

themes.transitions_note: LOG-185 / ADR-012 (user 2026-09-12 16:35 「已經調好了，可以應用了」): one rule per (from, to) pair, generated from the Transition Lab checklist plan_final_0912_2241.json (2026-09-12 22:41, 「紀錄後更新上線」; the 16:36 plan before it) by _tools_transition/apply_plan.py - edit the plan or the script, not this list. `from` = a section id, or A for the intro AND A2 (both hand over like A); `to` = a section id, I for the outro, or A for any hand-back to A (A1 later pass / A2 - the simple stage only). `layers` = seamLayers keys, every one starting preBars before the seam on the audio clock, armed at the decision with the next section and taken back with it. `noPre` = the incoming section enters ON the seam at its logical start (its own pick-up is skipped); `noTail` = the outgoing section stops at the seam (its tail does not ring across); with both gone the 15 ms crossfade applies, as if the data said 0. `mute` = {layer: [note ordinals]} silenced from that onset (layer.notes) to the next listed onset or the end. `random` = the variants the user listed for that seam, one drawn per seam (an empty layers list = nothing). `assumed` marks the readings where the tick and the note disagreed.
